captionStarter: Justin Verlander's final career start ends in a walk-off. Tigers 4, Pirates 3.
concept: Meme of the Week slide: 21 years of Verlander highlights ending with a walk-off trot at Comerica Park
description: The Detroit Tigers rallied to beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 4-3 on a game-ending two-run homer by Eduardo Valencia in Justin Verlander's final career start.
headline: Justin Verlander walks off in his final career start
